latest_release.name: Tantivy v0.26.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: Release by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2686
* update release instructions by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2687
* feat: Regex query grammar by @Darkheir in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2677
* Update CHANGELOG.md for bugfixes by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2674
* This PR changes the logic used on the ingestion of floats. by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2692
* Add fast field fallback for term query if not indexed by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2693
* Optimize ExistsQuery for a high number of dynamic columns by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2694
* Fix CI with rust 1.90 by @rdettai-sk in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2696
* fix compiler warnings by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2699
* clippy by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2700
* perf: deduplicate queries by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2698
* add and/or queries benchmark by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2701
* improve naming in buffered_union by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2705
* docs: correct grammar by @msmoiz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2704
* refactor postings by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2709
* Add DocSet::cost() by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2707
* Replace AggregationsWithAccessor by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2715
* Minor clarifications on the AggregationsWithAccessor refacto by @rdettai-sk in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2716
* Add Filtering for Term Aggregations by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2717
* fix merge intermediate aggregation results by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2719
* use FxHashMap for Aggregations Request by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2722
* cleanup by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2724
* Removing obsolete benchmark screenshot by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2730
* remove duplicated call to `index_writer.commit` in example by @Platane in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2732
* feat: added filter aggregation by @mdashti in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2711
* Optimize term aggregation with low cardinality + some refactoring by @fulmicoton-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2740
* clippy by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2741
* remove unused columnar api by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2742
* Optimization when posting list are saturated. by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2745
* split Term in Term and IndexingTerm by @PSeitz-dd in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2744
* Revert "remove unused columnar api (#2742)" by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2748
* fix: Handle phrase prefixed with star by @Darkheir in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2751
* Fix typos again by @kianmeng in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2753
* Implement `collect_block` for `Collector`s which wrap other `Collector`s by @stuhood in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2727
* Added some benchmark for top K by a fast field by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2754
* Lazy scorers by @fulmicoton in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2726
* docs: add usage example to README by @rustmailer in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2743
* fix unsafe warnings by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwit-oss/tantivy/pull/2757
* add term->histogram benchmark by @PSeitz in https://github.com/quickwi
